versions.name: Glendale Outdoor Leadership School
versions.summary: A Palmetto Area Council outdoor leadership campus near the Pacolet River in Glendale, outside Spartanburg, South Carolina, offering climbing, bouldering, STEM, and team-building experiences alongside leadership courses and Cub Scout day camp.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Palmetto Area Council GOLS page, which lists it as one of the council's two owned properties operated as a camping and training facility. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; classified as a program/training center with Cub day-camp use; features unsurveyed.
